package.name: service_info_client_cpp
package.description: issue 2148 -- the C++ twin of the service-info-client probe: an AddTwoInts client that takes each reply with rclcpp's Client::take_response(response, request_header) and prints the rmw_request_id_t, so interop_e2e can ask a stock rmw_zenoh_cpp server whether the header names the request it answers.
